definitions.explanation: A film that records and presents real events, people, or topics rather than telling a fictional story.

examples.japanese: ⟦{戦争|せんそう}→戦争：01450_sensou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{記録映画|きろくえいが}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{観|み}た→観る：22793_miru⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{記録映画|きろくえいが}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{自然|しぜん}→自然：01423_shizen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{美|うつく}しさ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見事|みごと}→見事：03744_migoto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧とらえて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: This documentary beautifully captures the beauty of nature.

examples.japanese: ⟦{被災地|ひさいち}→被災地：27434_hisaichi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{復興|ふっこう}→復興：07590_fukkou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦テーマ→テーマ：17684_teema⟧にした{記録映画|きろくえいが}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{映画祭|えいがさい}→映画祭：30642_eigasai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{上映|じょうえい}→上映：08380_jouei⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: A documentary about the recovery of the disaster-affected area was screened at the film festival.

notes:
The traditional Japanese term for documentary film, composed of ⟦{記録|きろく}→記録：02490_kiroku⟧ (record, documentation) and ⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧ (movie, film). While ⟦ドキュメンタリー→ドキュメンタリー：05250_dokyumentarii⟧ (the loanword) is also widely used in modern Japanese, {記録映画|きろくえいが} remains the standard native term.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {記録映画|きろくえいが}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{撮|と}る→撮る：00760_toru⟧ — to shoot a documentary
- {記録映画|きろくえいが}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{制作|せいさく}する→制作する：25535_seisakusuru⟧ — to produce a documentary
- {記録映画|きろくえいが}⟦{監督|かんとく}→監督：00185_kantoku⟧ — documentary filmmaker
- {記録映画|きろくえいが}{祭|さい} — documentary film festival

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦ドキュメンタリー→ドキュメンタリー：05250_dokyumentarii⟧ — documentary (loanword; more common in casual speech and TV)
- {劇映画|げきえいが} — feature film, narrative film (fictional; the counterpart)
- ⟦{娯楽映画|ごらくえいが}→娯楽映画：26199_gorakueiga⟧ — entertainment film (focuses on commercial appeal)

USAGE:
{記録映画|きろくえいが} tends to sound more formal or traditional than ⟦ドキュメンタリー→ドキュメンタリー：05250_dokyumentarii⟧. It is preferred in academic writing, film criticism, and historical contexts.
